body_lead: MADURAI: The ancient temple city of Madurai may well emerge as a modern technology hub in a few years from now if the proposal submitted to Tamil Nadu government today by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Madurai Zone is accepted and takes shape make it a hub of Artificial Intelligence (AI) units.
